source_evidence: Current source expresses the structural description: src/flic.cpp:1091-1168 (working-tree sha256 5aed0278500375275dbb876fda4d85075941a0293b37f730615521ce2eaad796, identical to the request's mapped source record) implements Flic::decode_byte_run_trans as a full product body - a 32-bit unsigned count reloaded as a dword by fread and masked & 0xff at every length use (memset arg line 1131, memcpy arg 1133, dst advance 1135, src advance 1136, remaining decrement 1124, literal bound 1155), the count slot reused for the literal run length via (uint8_t)abs((int8_t)count) with byte store-back (1138-1139) under an unsigned count > 0 guard (1141), and one byte-typed value slot shared by run and literal paths (1115, 1127-1130, 1143-1146); the accepted spelling was left unedited exactly as the discovery reports.
